title: Saigon war-history half day
summary: The War Remnants Museum and the Reunification Palace. Ticket prices are listed more than one way. How long each visit takes is Check on arrival.

stops.name: War Remnants Museum
stops.note: Open 7:30–17:30, last admission 17:00. An adult ticket is 60,000 đồng from 1 October 2026, and 15,000 đồng is also listed.

approach.note: Walk to the museum on Võ Văn Tần.

stops.name: Reunification Palace
stops.note: Open 07:00–18:00. The palace alone is 40,000 đồng. An adult ticket is also listed at 80,000 đồng.
